svg.text: Window functions — the arguments, in order
● 1 2 3 4 = the function's own arguments, in position order · ■ A–F = the shared tail that follows · solid box = required · blue = your Day 18 value
■ A–F — the shared tail: all optional, always in this order, after each function's own arguments
The list of rows to line up.
Restart at a level of the
Skip an optional argument with an empty comma — Step 1's OFFSET(-1, , ORDERBY(…)) is 1, then A skipped, then B.
A and B (relation, ORDERBY) are what you'll set almost every time; D is common; C, E and F are rare.
